main.summary:
Backend engineer with {{CAREER_DURATION}} of experience across 4 domains (Education, Healthcare, Clinical Trials, Gaming), leading 20+ projects and achieving quantifiable results including 82% BigQuery cost reduction, CDK-based analytics infrastructure as code, and building an internal NPM package system.

Specialized in system design from monolithic to Event-Driven serverless architectures, pursuing developer productivity improvements as demonstrated in the Games on AWS 2025 presentation on generative AI adoption, and creating long-term business value through GCP-AWS hybrid data pipeline construction and root cause analysis.

items: BigQuery read method migration — 82% cloud cost reduction ($6.25→$1.1 per TB)
Bulk data processing optimization — ORM bulk operation reducing sync time by 72%
DB query bottleneck resolution — table normalization and index optimization (18s→0.5s)
Serverless event-driven architecture — batch processing 2hrs→5min, data pipeline 270x expansion
Game admin logic and shared utility package system — code consistency across 12 projects
Legacy architecture modernization — monolith to NestJS modular migration, TDD 80%+ achieving zero post-deployment incidents
Root cause analysis — DB Deadlock foreign key lock timing identified, monthly 5+ notification failures → 0
Data consistency design — outbox pattern (event integrity), distributed lock (concurrency control)
Game probability regulatory compliance — integrated probability package across 12 projects + CDK audit log pipeline

skills.description: REST API design, microservice architecture, test automation

experience.description: Mobile game development and publishing company
highlights: Achieved 82% BigQuery cost reduction ($6.25→$1.1 per TB) by switching to Storage Read API to address escalating marketing data query costs

projects.name: Glider Sheet Audit Log System
projects.description: Resolved delayed balance issue response caused by inability to track data change history during game operations

3-Way Merge Engine: Multi-environment version merge system with parent/child entity conflict detection and unique constraint handling across 6 games
Version Diff Engine: Dual strategy of incremental comparison and snapshot comparison based on Base Audit availability for cost-efficient version diffing
Shared identifier-based Identification: Decoupled from PK dependency, ensuring accurate entity tracking during migration, comparison, and merge

Meta Asset Sync Performance Optimization: ORM single-row saves to bulk operations conversion reducing Image sync time by 72% (25.7s→7.1s), DB transactions by 95% (10~16s→0.3~0.5s)
Lambda ARM64 Migration: Graviton2 architecture migration reducing creative processing Lambda costs by 20%
BigQuery Storage Read API Adoption: gRPC streaming-based high-performance data reading reducing BigQuery costs by 82% ($6.25→$1.1 per TB)
DB Optimization: Normalized 100+ column table (main/time-series/prediction split), index optimization and cursor-based pagination resolving 18-second query bottleneck

projects.name: AWS Lambda Migration & Event-Driven Architecture
projects.description: Resolved batch job limitations from marketing metrics 60-day → 360-day expansion and serverless transition for batch processing

Transactional Outbox Pattern: Scheduled and delayed event publishing ensuring data consistency
Lambda Operational Stabilization: Batch Size bulk processing resolving throttling, CloudWatch log optimization reducing costs, build OOM remediation
RDS Proxy Connection Management: Resolved DB connection exhaustion during massive Lambda execution via RDS Proxy pooling
